axes.name: REVERSAL-BY-CONSTRUCTION
axes.attack: Trading toward absorption means trading AGAINST fresh 20-bar extremes: this is a short-horizon reversal state by construction, whatever the Wyckoff story says. The V5 veto class is not hypothetical: FOREX-NG5 killed BOTH positioning families at |rho| 0.230/0.353 vs plain close-to-close momentum. A2 declares momentum as top veto risk but does not name the reversal-form controls; an unnamed control is an unrun control.
binding_controls: MOM20: signed rho of the frozen pooled position series vs log(C_t/C_{t-20}); bar |rho| <= 0.20
REV1: 1-day reversal form, position = -sign(C_t - C_{t-1}); REV5: 5-day reversal form, position = -sign(C_t - C_{t-5}); bar |rho| <= 0.20 each

CTL-EXTREMEONLY: book that fades the fresh 20-bar CLOSE extreme with NO CLV condition. This decomposes the anchor: if it captures most of the anchor's edge, the 'divergence' adds nothing and the mechanism is an extreme-fade relabel (V8 exposure-form class).
The veto is on |rho|, not signed rho: signed overlap with momentum is expected NEGATIVE by construction, and a large NEGATIVE rho is still the same killed ancestry (a reversal book with new words).
Per-leg AND pooled rho both measured on the frozen P12 representation (fng7_a2_p1_daily16NY_v1); pooled-only measurement dilutes and is not accepted as PASS evidence.
axes.mechanism_fingerprint_mismatch: The mechanism statement anchors stop clusters 'beyond the visible K-bar extreme' (bar H/L, where stops actually sit), but the observable tests C_t vs rolling 20-bar CLOSE min/max. Close-extremes are a weaker proxy for stop-run prints; the fingerprint gap weakens mechanism specificity and raises the burden on the complement control (axis 8). Declared here so D1 cannot paper over it.

axes.name: VOL/TREND SHADOW
axes.attack: CLV accumulated over 20 bars IS a trend/accumulation measure; a fresh 20-bar extreme IS partly a volatility/range-expansion event. The 'divergence' trigger is therefore a candidate vol-level/trend relabel of the V4/V8 lineage (V4: carry relabels rho 0.997–1.000; V8: control same-sign >= anchor => exposure-form). The trigger is also a close cousin of Williams %R / stochastic divergence — a named TA class with a weak prior, as A2 itself discloses.
binding_controls: CTL-TRENDONLY: position = -sign(P_t - P_{t-5}) (trade against the CLV slope alone, no extreme condition). If it out-earns or matches the anchor, the extreme condition is decoration.
CTL-EXTREMEONLY (shared with axis 1): the trend-only/extrusion decomposition must jointly bound where the edge lives.

VOL-REGIME shadow: rho of the position series vs 20-bar realized vol (per leg, and vs realized-vol tercile dummies); plus a fold split by vol regime — if all anchor edge sits in one vol tercile the family is a vol-regime conditional (V3/V4 class) and must say so or die.

V8 exposure-form rule bound in: any declared control passing gates with same-sign performance >= 0.5x anchor => exposure-form, no mechanism specificity, anchor killed regardless of the control's own promotability.

'Fires unconditional on any clock' (A2's distinctness claim) is a claim about the rule's text, not about where its states actually land.

If it out-earns or matches the anchor at STRESS_TIER_2.0 PRIMARY => kill (V1-clock precedent).

axes.name: COST CEILING (1–3 bar holds)
axes.attack: With 1–3 bar holds the ceiling is SPREAD-dominated, not financing-dominated — the opposite of NG5's E1. Trigger rate is NOT_MEASURED (A2 says so honestly); the honest form: under an exchangeable-bars null, P(close is fresh 20-bar min) ~ 1/20 per side => ~10% of bars fire either side gross; the opposing-slope condition cuts that. FORM: trigger in [0.02, 0.10] of bars per leg => 250 TD bars => 5–25 round trips/leg/yr => 25–125 round trips/yr across 5 legs. At the 1.5 bps round-trip floor that is 0.4–1.9 bps/yr/leg of pure drag; at STRESS_TIER_2.0 PRIMARY (2.0x) the per-trade break-even hurdle is 3.0 bps before financing. A 1–3 bar FX drift must clear 3.0 bps gross with PF >= 1.10 — the exact class V6 died in (BE 3.475 vs 1.5 floor, PF 1.0979 vs 1.10, margin −0.0021).
axes.contrast_with_E1: NG5's E1 18.07 bps was a FINANCING-inclusive ceiling on WEEKLY holds (swap over a full week at stress 6 with NZ−US 6.23% worst differential). Short holds bound financing to <= ~5 bps over 3 nights on the worst leg (6.23%/365 x 3 nights ~ 5.1 bps) — E1 class avoided, as A2 claims. But the surviving ceiling is the spread break-even, and it is TIGHTER per unit of expected edge than E1 was: short holds realize the full round-trip spread every ~1.3 days.
binding_requirements: P0 must MEASURE the trigger rate empirically from the archived legs (state counts per leg per fold) BEFORE scoring; a scored run without a measured population is NOT_RUN for R5, never inferred PASS.

Break-even bps reported per arm per leg at STRESS_TIER_2.0 PRIMARY; R5 (BE <= 1.5 bps => dead) stands; the plan must also pre-pin the population floor (S2 class: per-state per-fold minimum, NG5 killed a family at 1/3) so thin populations cannot masquerade as an edge.
Serial clustering: consecutive fresh-extreme bars fire overlapping states; PF/trade-count independence assumptions must be declared or trade-level statistics will overcount effective bets.
If measured trigger lands below the fold-population floor, the family dies on population, not on cost — record which gate fired.

axes.pit_scoping_rule: A control state not knowable at decision time is RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY. Adjudication rule (asymmetric): a RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY series MAY kill — it may veto a family, fail a shadow gate, or close an ancestry claim, because correlation with an unknowable state is evidence the anchor loads a non-mechanistic or untradable state (conservative direction). It MAY NOT rescue — it can never validate a mechanism, pass a gate, construct or time the signal, or flip any fail into a pass, and it is never cited as PIT evidence. Applied to the A3 contract: (i) NY Fed channel is RETRIEVAL_TIME_ONLY with a measured T+1 publication bracket (absent 05:19 ET, present 09:40 ET) and 10 rows/rate in store — the current store is a connectivity/authenticity sample only; usable as a historical D2 control ONLY after a daily-fetch collector with per-row retrieval timestamps runs post-~09:00 ET for the cycle's window (PROSPECTIVE-ELIGIBLE going forward). (ii) OFR mirrors are RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY: funding-regime narrative and kill-only; FORBIDDEN in any historical scored join, any same-day control, or any claim a control state was knowable at decision time; measured mirror lag (OFR newest 2026-09-14 while NY Fed served 2026-09-15) bars same-day use. (iii) NO-FORWARD-FILL is binding in both stores: isolated single-weekday holiday absences stay ABSENT in any as-of join — a filled holiday row would be a synthetic state that was never published; any named fill rule must be frozen in the plan pre-score and would still be kill-only evidence. (iv) Identity ruling accepted: SOFR/EFFR/BGCR/TGCR/OBFR are USD funding/reference rates — funding/liquidity regime CONTROLS only, never an FX signal input; identity audit passes.

axes.name: COMPLEMENT CONTROL NULL-VALIDITY (Q-11)
axes.attack: The confirmed-extremes complement is the family's causal pivot (falsification-by-control, R3, cluster #17 candidate; nearest ancestor FXFV2-A4-P2's 'control ~ anchor => mechanism not specific'). A complement comparison is only a VALID null under strict semantics; otherwise a kill is fabricated from an unpopulated book or a rescue is smuggled through a mismatched control.
explicit_adjudication_rule: VALID NULL requires all of: (N1) the complement is scored on the IDENTICAL representation (P12), cost band, stress tier and fold structure as the anchor — no handicap in either direction; (N2) complement population is non-degenerate: pre-pinned minimum states/trades per fold and overall (S2-class floor; NG5 killed a family at 1/3 populated), measured from the pinned archive at P0; (N3) both books' folds populated per the fold-positivity sub-gate.

KILL semantics (R3 fires): with a VALID null, complement fin-adj expectancy >= anchor fin-adj expectancy at STRESS_TIER_2.0 PRIMARY — including EXACT MATCH (margin <= 0, conservative tie-break) — => the divergence carries no information, mechanism not specific, FNG7-A2-P1 REJECTED and numbered as a falsification-by-control cluster instance.

Falsification-artifact sub-rule (V15 CTL-ELITELEVEL precedent): if the complement out-earns the anchor AND the complement itself fails its own robustness gates, the anchor kill STANDS (the anchor is less specific than a broken strategy) and the complement is recorded as a falsification artifact, NEVER promotable.

INVALID NULL semantics: if N1–N3 fail — complement population degenerate or fold-unpopulated, or scored on a mismatched representation/cost/stress — the R3 comparison is an INVALID NULL: record R3 as NOT_RUN for the affected gate; the family can neither be killed via R3 nor PASS via R3 (missing evidence = NOT_RUN, never inferred PASS in either direction). The cycle then either fixes the spec pre-score (identical representation, floors pinned) or closes R3 NOT_RUN and the family cannot be promoted.
No post-hoc floor shopping: population floors and the tie rule are frozen at P0, before any complement PnL exists — else the null is negotiable and the control is theatre.
